cases.sentence: Получив власть через богатство, он поднимет всех против ___.
cases.explain: «Греческого царства» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia; and the fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

cases.sentence: Тогда появится ___, который будет править с великой властью и делать, что пожелает.
cases.explain: «могучий царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

cases.sentence: — ___ станет очень силен, но один из его военачальников станет сильнее его и будет править своим царством с великой силой.
cases.explain: «Южный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

cases.sentence: — Южный царь станет очень силен, но один из его военачальников станет сильнее его и будет править своим царством с ___.
cases.explain: «великой силой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

cases.sentence: Дочь ___ за северного царя, чтобы скрепить союз, но она не удержит власти, и его потомство не продолжится.
cases.explain: «южного царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement; but she will not retain the strength of her arm. He will also not stand, nor will his arm; but she will be given up, with those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

cases.sentence: Он пойдет против войска ___ и войдет в его крепость; он будет воевать с ними и одержит победу.
cases.explain: «северного царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army, and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them, and will prevail.

cases.sentence: Тогда ___ вторгнется в державу южного царя, но возвратится в свою страну.
cases.explain: «северный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

cases.sentence: Тогда северный царь вторгнется в державу ___, но возвратится в свою страну.
cases.explain: «южного царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

cases.sentence: Тогда ___ в гневе выступит и сразится с северным царем, набравшим большое войско, которое, однако, будет разбито.
cases.explain: «южный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The king of the south will be moved with anger, and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

cases.sentence: Когда войско будет уведено, ___ возгордится и убьет многие тысячи, но не достигнет победы.
cases.explain: «южный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The multitude will be lifted up, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.

cases.sentence: ___ соберет другое войско, больше первого, и через несколько лет выступит с огромным войском, полностью снаряженным.
cases.explain: «Северный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with much substance.

cases.sentence: Северный царь соберет другое войско, больше первого, и через несколько лет выступит с ___, полностью снаряженным.
cases.explain: «огромным войском» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with much substance.

cases.sentence: В те времена многие восстанут против ___.
cases.explain: «южного царя» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they will fall.

cases.sentence: Неистовые из твоего ___ восстанут во исполнение видения, но безуспешно.
cases.explain: «собственного народа» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they will fall.

cases.sentence: Тогда ___ придет, насыплет осадный вал и возьмет укрепленный город.
cases.explain: «северный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his chosen people, neither will there be any strength to stand.

cases.sentence: Тогда он обратит взгляд на ___ и захватит многие из них, но некий военачальник положит конец его дерзости; истинно, он обратит его дерзость против него же.
cases.explain: «прибрежные области» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many; but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

cases.sentence: — На его место явится ___, не облеченный царским величием.
cases.explain: «презренный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

cases.sentence: — На его место явится презренный человек, не облеченный ___.
cases.explain: «царским величием» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

cases.sentence: Перед ним будет сметено ___; оно будет погублено вместе с вождем завета.
cases.explain: «неисчислимое войско» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.

cases.sentence: Заключив с ним союз, он станет действовать обманом и лишь с ___ придет к власти.
cases.explain: «немногими людьми» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up, and will become strong, with a small people.

cases.sentence: С ___ он соберет свои силы и смело выступит против южного царя.
cases.explain: «большим войском» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army; but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

cases.sentence: С большим войском он соберет свои силы и смело выступит против ___.
cases.explain: «южного царя» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army; but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

cases.sentence: ___ будет вести войну с большим и очень сильным войском, но не сможет устоять из-за заговоров, составленных против него.
cases.explain: «Южный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army; but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

cases.sentence: ___ вернется в свою страну с великим богатством, но сердце его будет настроено против святого завета.
cases.explain: «Северный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

cases.sentence: Северный царь вернется в свою страну с ___, но сердце его будет настроено против святого завета.
cases.explain: «великим богатством» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

cases.sentence: Северный царь вернется в свою страну с великим богатством, но сердце его будет настроено против ___.
cases.explain: «святого завета» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

cases.sentence: Ему преградят путь корабли с ___ , и он падет духом.
cases.explain: «западных побережий» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

cases.sentence: Он возвратится и будет благосклонен к тем, кто отступил от ___.
cases.explain: «святого завета» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

cases.sentence: Вместо них он будет чтить бога крепостей; бога, неизвестного его отцам, он будет чествовать золотом и серебром, ___ и дорогими дарами.
cases.explain: «драгоценными камнями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But in his place he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

cases.sentence: Вместо них он будет чтить бога крепостей; бога, неизвестного его отцам, он будет чествовать золотом и серебром, драгоценными камнями и ___.
cases.explain: «дорогими дарами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But in his place he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

cases.sentence: Он нападет на самые сильные крепости с помощью ___.
cases.explain: «чужого бога» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.

cases.sentence: В конце времен на него нападет ___.
cases.explain: «южный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

cases.sentence: Но ___ обрушится на него как ураган, с колесницами, всадниками и многочисленными кораблями.
cases.explain: «северный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

cases.sentence: Но северный царь обрушится на него как ураган, с колесницами, всадниками и ___.
cases.explain: «многочисленными кораблями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

cases.sentence: ___ падут, но Эдом, Моав и вожди Аммона будут избавлены от его руки.
cases.explain: «Многие страны» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

cases.sentence: Но известия с востока и севера встревожат его, и он выйдет в ___ истреблять и губить многих.
cases.explain: «страшном гневе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

cases.sentence: Он разобьет свои царские шатры между морем и прекрасной ___.
cases.explain: «святой горой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
